HIGH RISK: allow a host-authenticated administrator to inspect sensitive device, IP, location, network, and anomaly metadata for all users inside native Settings.

DESTRUCTIVE, HIGH RISK: allow administrators to upload and replace host GeoIP databases after explicit confirmation.
